Seed Token (OpenCRVS → MOSIP).description: Seed a token to MOSIP's Token Seeder service — this is the bridge step used by the OpenCRVS-MOSIP mediator pattern to create a national ID from a birth registration.

Request Credential.description: Request a credential issuance from the partner-facing credential service. Includes the DataShare policy id and the partner id.

Subscribe to WebSub Topic.description: Send the WebSub subscription discovery + subscribe request so MOSIP starts publishing the chosen topic to your callback URL.

API Request (Beta).description: Raw HTTP call against any MOSIP partner API.
API Request (Beta).code:
// Hit a MOSIP partner endpoint directly.
request('/v1/identity/auth', { method: 'POST', data: { /* ... */ } });

Fetch DataShare Payload.description: When a MOSIP event arrives with a DataShare URL, fetch the actual credential / biographic payload from the temporary URL.
Fetch DataShare Payload.code:
// Download a DataShare payload referenced by a MOSIP event.
request($.data.dataShareUrl, { method: 'GET' });

Get UIN Status.description: Look up the current status of a UIN via ID Repository.
Get UIN Status.code:
// Get UIN status from ID Repository.
request(`/idrepository/v1/identity/uin/${$.data.uin}`, { method: 'GET' });
